stringRecommender.styleQuestion: What do you want from your strings?

reason.attack: A grippy, hard-feeling string helps a {skill} player transfer more bite and weight into steep shots.
reason.all-round: A durable, forgiving string gives a {skill} player a dependable mix of power, control and string life.
reason.speed: A thin, repulsive string helps a {skill} player get the shuttle away quickly in drives and fast exchanges.
reason.defence: A lively string with a softer response helps a {skill} player lift and counter with less effort.
reason.control: A textured hybrid gives a {skill} player extra hold for slices, tight net shots and placement.

stringRecommender.safety: This suggestion stays within the racket's published limit of {max}. Ask your stringer to adjust for condition, climate and warranty.

methodology.title: How the Court Score is calculated
methodology.intro: The score is two halves, published in full. Sellers cannot influence either one.
methodology.specBody: Deterministic, computed from the catalogue record. The same specs always produce the same number.
methodology.playerBody: Averaged from verified reviews on the same four axes, weighted by verification tier.
methodology.minReviews: A Player Score is withheld until a racket has {count} verified reviews. Below that the page says "spec profile only" and shows the spec half on its own.
methodology.axisWeightsBody: The axes are not equal. A flat average would rank a 72 g beginner frame above a flagship, because lightness buys both speed and comfort for free while power and control have to be earned.
methodology.axisPower: Power = f(balance point, shaft flex, weight)
methodology.noSaleBody: Promoted placement is labelled on the offers table and is excluded from the score, from the default sort, and from the Finder shortlist.

check.title: Check a listing you found
check.intro: Enter the racket, the asking price and its condition. No account needed, and nothing about the post is stored.
check.metaDescription: Check a racket listing from a Facebook group: fit, price evidence and questions to ask the seller.
check.sampleData: Sample data: this preview runs on the seeded catalogue, so prices are illustrative rather than live market prices.
check.modelUnconfirmedBody: Without a catalogue model there is no fit or price answer yet. Search the catalogue for it, or use the questions below with the seller.
check.missingTitle: This model is not in the catalogue.
check.missingBody: Search the catalogue with a shorter name, for example the series and number, or start the check again.
check.fitNeedsProfileBody: Add three answers about how you play for a fit answer. The specs and tradeoffs below hold either way.
check.fitNoReason: Nothing in the specs stands out for how you play, for or against.
check.addProfile: Add answers about how you play
check.reasonBeginner: Built for developing players and forgiving at {mm} mm balance.
check.reasonRear: Head-heavy at {mm} mm, which is where the weight goes for rear-court attack.
check.reasonNet: {mm} mm balance keeps the head quick for exchanges at the net.
check.reasonDoubles: Speed scores {speed} on the spec profile, suited to flat doubles exchanges.
check.reasonSingles: Power scores {power} on the spec profile, which is what a singles rally ends with.
check.reasonControl: Control scores {control}, so it holds the shuttle long enough to place it.
check.concernSkill: Built for a more advanced player than your answers describe. It will feel demanding until your swing catches up.
check.concernStiffBeginner: A stiff shaft needs a fast, full swing to bend, which is hard to find in your first year.
check.concernRear: Head-light at {mm} mm, so rear-court smashes get less help from the frame.
check.concernNet: Head-heavy at {mm} mm, so the head is slower back for fast net exchanges.
check.tradeHeadHeavy: Head-heavy at {mm} mm: more weight behind smashes, slower in fast drives and defence.
check.tradeHeadLight: Head-light at {mm} mm: quick at the net and in defence, less free power on smashes.
check.tradeEven: Even at {mm} mm: an all-rounder that does not lead in attack or in speed.
check.tradeStiff: A stiff shaft rewards a fast swing with precision and punishes a late or short one.
check.tradeFlexible: A flexible shaft helps a slower swing but is less precise on fast, full smashes.
check.priceTitle: What we can say about the price
check.evidenceLine: {count, plural, =1 {1 offer} other {# offers}} from {sellers, plural, =1 {1 seller} other {# sellers}} · {variant} · {condition} · newest {date}
check.askingBelow: The asking price is below every comparable offer. Check condition and authenticity before treating that as a good sign.
check.askingWithin: The asking price is within the range of comparable offers.
check.askingAbove: The asking price is above every comparable offer. Ask the seller why, or compare with the retail offers.
check.refVariant: Price depends on weight and grip. Confirm the variant to compare like with like.
check.refUsed: Timvot tracks retail offers, not used sales, so a used listing is not judged against new prices.
check.refUnknown: Condition not given, so no price comparison is made.
check.staleBody: Offers exist for this variant and condition, but none were confirmed in the last {hours} hours.
check.insufficientBody: A price comparison needs {min} current offers from {sellers} different sellers for this variant and condition. There are not enough yet.
check.evidenceSource: Source: retailer listings Timvot tracks. The price you entered is not part of the evidence.
check.copyFailed: Copy failed. Select the text and copy it yourself.
check.askVariant: Which exact version is it: weight class (3U or 4U), grip size and colour?
check.askAuthenticity: Can you send a photo of the serial or authenticity sticker, and the purchase receipt?
check.askWarranty: Is the manufacturer's warranty still valid, and who handles a claim?
check.askStringing: Is it strung? If so, with which string and at what tension?
check.askPhotos: Can you send close-up photos of the frame head, grommets, shaft and grip?
check.askDamage: Has it had any cracks, repairs or repainting, and how often has it been played?
check.askInspect: Can I inspect it in person before paying?
check.inspectionTitle: Before paying for a used racket
check.inspectFrame: Frame head: look for cracks, dents and paint lifting along the top and sides.
check.inspectGrommets: Grommets: broken or missing grommets let strings cut the frame.
check.inspectShaft: Shaft and T-joint: look for hairline cracks and a head that twists against the handle.
check.inspectGrip: Grip and handle: a loose cap or a rebuilt handle can hide damage.
check.inspectRepairs: Repairs: fresh paint or filler over one spot often marks an old crack.
check.inspectInPerson: Inspect in person, and confirm the weight and grip match what was advertised.
check.noCertificate: Timvot cannot confirm that a racket nobody has inspected is genuine.
check.shareNote: The link carries the model, variant, price and condition only.
check.noAlternatives: No close alternatives found yet. Browse the catalogue by the same balance and stiffness to find some.
